newsitem.title: UK: Copper ends near highs on LME, late trade busy.
newsitem.headline: Copper ends near highs on LME, late trade busy.

text.p: COPPER - Ends near $2,380 after frantic late trade. Spec buyers out in force after regaining $2,350. Backwardation snaps out to $85
ALUMINIUM - Closes firmer and constructively above $1,640.
ZINC - Perks up to end steadier. LEAD - Finishes higher.
NICKEL - Extends gains above $7,300, ends firmer.
TIN - Closes steadier, but trade lacklustre.
